mapper.sql: SELECT CONCAT('workspaces/', #{workspaceId}, '/attachments/', SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.url, '/', -1)) AS object_key, 'attachment' AS kind, 0 AS owner_id, a.url AS persisted_url FROM attachment a WHERE a.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND a.url LIKE '/api/attachments/content/%' AND (a.entity_type <> 'ai_chat_session' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ai_chat_session s WHERE s.workspace_id = a.workspace_id AND s.id = a.entity_id AND s.organization_privacy_generation = #{organizationPrivacyGeneration})) UNION DISTINCT SELECT CONCAT('workspaces/', #{workspaceId}, '/person-images/', p.id, '/', SUBSTRING_INDEX(p.image_url, '/', -1)) AS object_key, 'person_image' AS kind, p.id AS owner_id, p.image_url AS persisted_url FROM person p WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.image_url LIKE CONCAT('/api/persons/', p.id, '/profile-picture/%') UNION DISTINCT SELECT CONCAT('workspaces/', #{workspaceId}, '/company-images/', c.id, '/', SUBSTRING_INDEX(c.logo_url, '/', -1)) AS object_key, 'company_image' AS kind, c.id AS owner_id, c.logo_url AS persisted_url FROM company c WHERE c.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND c.logo_url LIKE CONCAT('/api/companies/', c.id, '/logo/%') UNION DISTINCT SELECT artifact.object_key, 'document_delivery_artifact' AS kind, artifact.delivery_id AS owner_id, artifact.object_key AS persisted_url FROM document_delivery_artifact artifact WHERE artifact.workspace_id = #{workspaceId}

SELECT candidates.object_key AS objectKey, candidates.kind, candidates.owner_id AS ownerId, candidates.persisted_url AS persistedUrl, u.size_bytes AS usageSizeBytes FROM (
) candidates LEFT JOIN managed_object_usage u ON u.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND u.object_key = candidates.object_key ORDER BY candidates.object_key

SELECT object_key FROM ( SELECT u.object_key FROM managed_object_usage u WHERE u.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} UNION DISTINCT SELECT queue.object_key FROM object_deletion_queue queue WHERE queue.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} UNION DISTINCT SELECT CONCAT('workspaces/', #{workspaceId}, '/attachments/', SUBSTRING_INDEX(a.url, '/', -1)) FROM attachment a WHERE a.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND a.url LIKE '/api/attachments/content/%' UNION DISTINCT SELECT CONCAT('workspaces/', #{workspaceId}, '/person-images/', p.id, '/', SUBSTRING_INDEX(p.image_url, '/', -1)) FROM person p WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.image_url LIKE CONCAT('/api/persons/', p.id, '/profile-picture/%') UNION DISTINCT SELECT CONCAT('workspaces/', #{workspaceId}, '/company-images/', c.id, '/', SUBSTRING_INDEX(c.logo_url, '/', -1)) FROM company c WHERE c.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND c.logo_url LIKE CONCAT('/api/companies/', c.id, '/logo/%') UNION DISTINCT SELECT artifact.object_key FROM document_delivery_artifact artifact WHERE artifact.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ) lifecycle_objects WHERE object_key > #{afterKey} ORDER BY object_key LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM attachment WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND url LIKE '/api/attachments/content/%' ) + ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM person WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND image_url LIKE CONCAT('/api/persons/', id, '/profile-picture/%') ) + ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM company WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND logo_url LIKE CONCAT('/api/companies/', id, '/logo/%') ) + ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM document_delivery_artifact WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} ) AS activeObjectCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM managed_object_usage WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId}) AS usageCount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(size_bytes), 0) FROM managed_object_usage WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId}) AS usageBytes, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM object_deletion_queue WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId}) AS pendingDeletionCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM object_storage_quota WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId}) AS quotaRows, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(object_count), 0) FROM object_storage_quota WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId}) AS quotaObjectCount, (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(used_bytes), 0) FROM object_storage_quota WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId}) AS quotaBytes
